title: Body buzzing for no clear reason?
caption: Body buzzing for no clear reason? The sky sent a small nudge, so focus may jump between sharp and foggy—try three minutes of slow breathing or a short walk when you feel squirrely.
snapshot: Overall space activity is quiet to normal with a single recent CME and a mildly elevated Schumann signal. The scene is not dramatic, yet it has a faint jitter that can feel like static on a signal. That can translate to a wired-tired blend for some folks today.
affects: You may feel jumpy and drained at the same time, with attention that skates between sharp and foggy. Sleep plans may still hold if evenings are quieter. Headaches or head pressure could be a low-level possibility for sensitive people.
playbook:
- Pause for three minutes of slow breathing when you feel buzzy
- Choose gentle movement like a short walk instead of intense exercise
- Limit stimulants and keep activity blocks short
- Use a warm snack or tea to cue calm

sections.voiceover: Mind feeling scattered or like there are too many tabs open? The field today is mostly calm with a slight misalignment, like a compass nudged off center — small enough to shift focus for some people. With normal solar wind and quiet flares, this often means attention dips in short waves instead of a long fog. That rhythm can help the brain settle without pushing hard. Gaia Eyes sees these steady days as good times to use gentle pacing to reclaim focus. Try this today: Pause for three minutes of slow breathing when you feel buzzy.
